title: Ensure 'Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths' is configured correctly
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths to strictly required paths only.
reason: Allowing remote access to the registry can lead to unauthorized changes to system configuration. Only specific, required paths should be allowed for access.

title: Ensure 'Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths and sub-paths' is configured correctly
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths and sub-paths to strictly required paths.
reason: If an attacker gains access to the registry, they could reconfigure security settings or steal credentials. Strict access controls limit this exposure.
